svg.text: J1 is wired pin-for-pin to the CoCo 3 keyboard connector (CN2). The firmware you flash decides which way the keystrokes go.
Original CoCo 3 keyboard → PC or emulator
Why a Pico 1: the CoCo keyboard is only switches, so everything stays at the Pico’s own 3.3 V.
Modern USB or Bluetooth keyboard → real CoCo 3
Why a Pico 2 W: the CoCo’s keyboard lines are 5 V logic, RP2350 GPIOs are 5 V tolerant, and it adds Bluetooth. Power it through J5.
